description: Modu (默读) is a cross-platform e-book and PDF reader with AI-assisted translation, built with Flutter
##: Windows installers are built with Inno Setup 6.7.3 (not NSIS); Scoop extracts them with innounp.
Main executable is modu.exe, confirmed by upstream docs/RELEASING.md.
Both 64-bit and ARM64 Windows builds are shipped; the ARM64 payload is included.
autoupdate.hash is omitted: the GitHub release asset carries a sha256 digest that Excavator reads automatically.
The Windows build has no Authenticode signature; verify the SHA-256 from the release page.
notes: Requires the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. The Windows build is not Authenticode-signed, so verify the published SHA-256 before trusting it.
